_: 土地島. Read by the page AND by the server (server/src/game/land.js), so a price is a price and a tier is a tier: the page draws what this file says and the room charges what this file says. The island block is the hub (three buildings round a yard, coordinates relative to its own x/z like every other island's JSON; colours are decimals because island-kit.js reads them as numbers). `tiers` are the six price steps a child climbs in order with coins only (no level), and each step offers `looks` — different worlds at the same price — one of which the child picks when buying; changing to another look of the same step later costs `restyle` of the price. `theme` names a builder in land-world.js. The research behind the numbers is docs/uspeak-land-research.md. Nothing here changes how any English is judged or paid.
